notes.title: A Tale of Two Kingdoms now available on MacOS
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms is now available on MacOS, just like our other games Heroine's Quest, Beer!, and the Crystal Shard Adventure Bundle. The Mac build uses Adventure Game Studio version 3.6.1.25, and should run on any Mac 64-bit computer running MacOS 10.15 or above. The Windows and Linux builds have not been changed.

Gameplay has not changed, but I'll consider a patch later this year if the Mac users (or anyone else) finds some major bugs. Enjoy, everyone, and have a great spring!

notes.title: ATOTK 2.0.6 (German) update
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms now has a German translation, courtesy of Brendan Ferreri-Hanberry!
Also, the game has been updated to fix bugs reported by Steam players. The new build is fully compatible with the previous one.[list]
[*] Enable joypad controls.
[*] Fix certain songs not playing properly.
[*] Fix GUI fonts in Hungarian translation.
[/list]

notes.title: A Tale of Two Kingdoms updated to newest AGS engine
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms has been updated to the latest stable version of Adventure Game Studio, 3.6.0 patch 5. This will improve stability on newer computers and compatibility with newer Windows versions. Saved games from 2.0 and up are fully compatible with 2.0.5.

A full list of engine changes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/forums/ags-engine-editor-releases/ags-3-6-0-patch-5/]here[/url].

Changes to gameplay:[list]
[*]Allow saving game in tutorial area.
[*]Fix missing animations while disguised.
[/list]

notes.title: ATOTK 2.0.4 update
notes.notes:
A Tale of Two Kingdoms has been updated to fix bugs reported by Steam players. The new build is fully compatible with the previous one.

[list]
[*] Fix coordinates for walking up kitchen stairs.
[*] Fix crash when restoring during one particular bird ambient.
[*] Fix easter egg character appearing during storm scene.
[*] Fix horseshoe remaining in shed after taking it.
[*] Fix hotkeys during language selection.
[*] Fix NPC positioning when entering room.
[*] Fix opening Ruadh's chest while disguised.
[*] Fix showing the same evidence more than once.
[*] Fix sound for defeating barghest.
[*] Fix statue description on the city bluff.
[*] Prevent taking second rope if Branwyn has the first one.
[/list]

notes.title: A Tale of Two Soundtracks
notes.notes: The soundtrack for ATOTK, previously a DLC package, has been converted to Steam's new sountrack system. This means that it is shown differently in the Steam interface, and that you can purchase and/or install the soundtrack without installing the base game. Notably, the soundtrack is available for Apple (since it's MP3 files), and the base game is not.

notes.title: Sub Terra Draconis
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=KXYtSxFe_7I;full][/previewyoutube]

From the makers of Heroine's Quest comes a challenging new puzzle game!

Newly hatched from an egg, our young dragon searches for the important things in life. And to a dragon, that means treasure! Search underground mazes and solve elaborate puzzles in your quest for gems, and see if you can hoard enough to impress the other dragons!

A classic puzzle with over a hundred levels and many different objects including treasure chests, replicators, floating balloons, fire beams, thieving elves, conveyor belts, gravity switches, and many more! Between all these traps, the levels require a good mixture of reflex action and thoughtful planning; and the varied mechanics keep things interesting to solve. Comes with a full set of achievements, leaderboards, and Steam Workshop to share your own levels!

notes.title: Soundtrack now available!
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/649020/A_Tale_of_Two_Soundtracks/

A Tale of Two Kingdoms has an engaging soundtrack of over thirty different pieces to add mood and atmosphere to the game, offering well over an hour of quality music. This soundtrack was shortlisted for Best Music of the Year in the AGS Awards. This newly available DLC package offers the entire OST in OGG format, so you can listen to it whenever you want. On behalf of the Crystal Shard team, enjoy!

We've also put all our adventure games together in a bundle, allowing you to get them at a nice discount (and an even bigger one during the Steam sales): http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5656
